# The IssueFilter composition, one row per family.
#
# A silently dropped family yields a valid filter over the WRONG issue set — a
# silent-wrong-answer failure rather than a crash — so the test that reads this
# file carries a row-coverage guard.
#
# The expected column is canonical JSON: serde_json emits object keys sorted.
# Order is not part of the contract; the fields are.
#
# Spec grammar, semicolon separated: team=, teams=, state=, assignee=, label=,
# project=, text=. A comma-separated value list lowers to `in` (values OR'd);
# a value resolving to a single id keeps `eq`. `teams=` adds further scoped
# teams, so the base and each additional team lower to one `id.in` list and
# every scoped team contributes its own ids. Ids within a family are sorted.
#
# The catalogue the test seeds: T1 carries states In Progress (s1-ip) and Done
# (s1-done), labels infra (l1-infra), a (l1-a) and b (l1-b), members alice
# (u-alice) and bob (u-bob), and projects Alpha (p-alpha) and Beta (p-beta).
# T2 carries In Progress (s2-ip), infra (l2-infra), alice and Alpha. T3
# carries In Progress (s3-ip) and nothing else.
#
# Columns: case <TAB> spec <TAB> expected filter
empty		{}
team	team=T1	{"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}}}
state	team=T1;state=In Progress	{"state":{"id":{"eq":"s1-ip"}},"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}}}
assignee	team=T1;assignee=alice	{"assignee":{"id":{"eq":"u-alice"}},"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}}}
label	team=T1;label=infra	{"labels":{"id":{"eq":"l1-infra"}},"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}}}
project	team=T1;project=Alpha	{"project":{"id":{"eq":"p-alpha"}},"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}}}
project-in	team=T1;project=Alpha,Beta	{"project":{"id":{"in":["p-alpha","p-beta"]}},"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}}}
text	text=needle	{"title":{"containsIgnoreCase":"needle"}}
every-family	team=T1;state=In Progress;assignee=alice;label=infra;project=Alpha;text=needle	{"assignee":{"id":{"eq":"u-alice"}},"labels":{"id":{"eq":"l1-infra"}},"project":{"id":{"eq":"p-alpha"}},"state":{"id":{"eq":"s1-ip"}},"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}},"title":{"containsIgnoreCase":"needle"}}
label-in	team=T1;label=a,b	{"labels":{"id":{"in":["l1-a","l1-b"]}},"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}}}
state-in	team=T1;state=In Progress,Done	{"state":{"id":{"in":["s1-done","s1-ip"]}},"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}}}
assignee-in	team=T1;assignee=alice,bob	{"assignee":{"id":{"in":["u-alice","u-bob"]}},"team":{"id":{"eq":"T1"}}}
team-in	team=T1;teams=T2,T3	{"team":{"id":{"in":["T1","T2","T3"]}}}
state-many-teams	team=T1;teams=T2,T3;state=In Progress	{"state":{"id":{"in":["s1-ip","s2-ip","s3-ip"]}},"team":{"id":{"in":["T1","T2","T3"]}}}
label-many-teams	team=T1;teams=T2;label=infra	{"labels":{"id":{"in":["l1-infra","l2-infra"]}},"team":{"id":{"in":["T1","T2"]}}}
